# Load packages

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(biomaRt)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(msigdbr)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(UCell)

library(circlize)

```



# Read in blood pea

### NOTE - database of proximity extension assays, which detect relative protein levels in the blood. Gives genes (which correpond to proteins) logFC values that correspond with changes relative to healthy controls or other disease conditions.

```{r, include=FALSE}
hpa_pea <- read_tsv("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/hpa/blood_pea_disease_de.tsv")
```


## Filter for cancer as the disease and for healthy as the control and remove the unnecessary columns

```{r, include=FALSE}
hpa_pea <- hpa_pea %>%
  dplyr::filter(Class == "Cancer", Control == "Healthy")

hpa_pea <- hpa_pea[, !names(hpa_pea) %in% c("Seeds", 
                                            "Mean importance", 
                                            "SD importance", 
                                            "Min importance", 
                                            "Max importance")]
```


## Identify logFC values of tumour secreted ligands (Tnf, Ccl12 which is Ccl2 in humans Cxcl12, Osm) found to regulate the muscle from our mouse analyses. These values are in the blood of tumour-bearing humans relative to healthy controls.

```{r}
target_proteins <- c("TNF", "CCL2", "CXCL12", "OSM")

hpa_pea_targets <- hpa_pea %>%
  filter(Gene %in% target_proteins)
```


## Add a column for cachexia risk

```{r, include=FALSE}
hpa_pea_targets <- hpa_pea_targets %>%
  mutate(Cachexia_risk = case_when(
    
    Disease %in% c(
      "Pancreatic cancer",
      "Lung cancer",
      "Colorectal cancer",
      "Hepatocellular cancer"
    ) ~ "High cachectic",
    
    Disease %in% c(
      "Metastatic melanoma",
      "Ovarian cancer",
      "Breast cancer",
      "Cervical cancer",
      "Endometrial cancer"
    ) ~ "Moderate cachectic",
    
    TRUE ~ "Low cachectic"
  ))

hpa_pea_targets$Cachexia_risk <- factor(
  hpa_pea_targets$Cachexia_risk,
  levels = c("Low cachectic", "Moderate cachectic", "High cachectic")
)
```


## Plot blood protein levels

### Define cancers from most to least cachectic (according to CHATGPT may need to reorder)

```{r, include=FALSE}
cachexia_order <- c(
  "Pituitary neuroendocrine tumor",
  "Meningioma",
  "Prostate cancer",
  "Glioma",
  "Endometrial cancer",
  "Cervical cancer",
  "Breast ductal carcinoma in situ",
  "Breast cancer",
  "Chronic lymphocytic leukemia",
  "Acute myeloid leukemia",
  "Myeloma",
  "Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma",
  "Ovarian cancer",
  "Metastatic melanoma",
  "Small intestine neuroendocrine tumor",
  "Hepatocellular cancer",
  "Colorectal cancer",
  "Lung cancer",
  "Pancreatic cancer"
)
```

### Filter genes

```{r, include=FALSE}
tnf_df <- hpa_pea_targets %>%
  filter(Gene == "TNF") %>%
  mutate(p_plot = ifelse(`p-value adjusted` > 0.05, NA, `p-value adjusted`))

ccl2_df <- hpa_pea_targets %>%
  filter(Gene == "CCL2") %>%
  mutate(p_plot = ifelse(`p-value adjusted` > 0.05, NA, `p-value adjusted`))

cxcl12_df <- hpa_pea_targets %>%
  filter(Gene == "CXCL12") %>%
  mutate(p_plot = ifelse(`p-value adjusted` > 0.05, NA, `p-value adjusted`))

osm_df <- hpa_pea_targets %>%
  filter(Gene == "OSM") %>%
  mutate(p_plot = ifelse(`p-value adjusted` > 0.05, NA, `p-value adjusted`))
```

### Plot TNF

```{r}
ggplot(
  tnf_df %>% mutate(Disease = factor(Disease, levels = cachexia_order)),
  aes(x = Disease, y = logFC, fill = p_plot)
) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "blue",
    high = "red",
    limits = c(min(tnf_df$p_plot, na.rm = TRUE), 0.05),
    na.value = "black",
    name = "Adjusted p-value"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Plasma TNF",
    x = "Cancer type (ranked by cachexia potential)",
    y = "logFC (relative to healthy controls)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

## TNF differences between cachexia risk

### 1-way ANOVA to compare pTPM values between cachexia risks

```{r}
tnf_anova <- aov(logFC ~ Cachexia_risk, data = tnf_df)

summary(tnf_anova)
```

### Plot

```{r}
ggplot(tnf_df, aes(x = Cachexia_risk, y = logFC, fill = Cachexia_risk)) +
  
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "solid",
    size = 0.6
  ) +
  
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "bar",
    color = "black",
    width = 0.6
  ) +
  
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_sdl,
    fun.args = list(mult = 1),
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    size = 0.8
  ) +
  
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = Disease),
    width = 0.15,
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "High cachectic" = "#666666",
    "Moderate cachectic" = "lightgrey",
    "Low cachectic" = "white"
  )) +
  
  labs(
  x = NULL,
  y = "Plasma TNF logFC (relative to healthy)"
) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, 2)) +
  
  theme_classic()
```

# Read in tumour RNA

```{r, include=FALSE}
tumour_rna <- read_tsv("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/hpa/rna_cancer_sample.tsv")
```


## Add gene names to data.frame

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Connect to Ensembl
mart <- useEnsembl(
  biomart = "genes",
  dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl"
)

# Get mapping table
gene_map <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hgnc_symbol"),
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values = unique(tumour_rna$Gene),
  mart = mart
)

# Join back to your dataframe
tumour_rna <- tumour_rna %>%
  left_join(gene_map,
            by = c("Gene" = "ensembl_gene_id")) %>%
  rename(Gene_symbol = hgnc_symbol)

# Drop NA values
tumour_rna <- tumour_rna %>%
  drop_na(Gene_symbol)

# Remove "TCGA" (from HPA) and "validation" (from publically available databases) from Cancer names
tumour_rna <- tumour_rna %>%
  mutate(
    Cancer = sub(" \\(.*\\)", "", Cancer)
  )
```


## Define  cancers from least to most cachectic (according to CHATGPT may need to reorder)

```{r, include=FALSE}
cachexia_order <- c(
  "Thyroid Carcinoma",
  "Testicular Germ Cell Tumor",
  "Stomach Adenocarcinoma",
  "Rectum Adenocarcinoma",
  "Kidney Renal Papillary Cell Carcinoma",
  "Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma",
  "Kidney Chromophobe",
  "Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma",
  "Bladder Urothelial Carcinoma",
  "Prostate Adenocarcinoma",
  "Glioblastoma Multiforme",
  "Uterine Corpus Endometrial Carcinoma",
  "Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma and Endocervical Adenocarcinoma",
  "Breast Invasive Carcinoma",
  "Ovary Serous Cystadenocarcinoma",
  "Skin Cuteneous Melanoma",
  "Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma",
  "Colon Adenocarcinoma",
  "Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma",
  "Lung Adenocarcinoma",
  "Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma"
)
```


## Add a column for high, moderate, and low cachexia

```{r}
tumour_rna <- tumour_rna %>%
  mutate(Cachexia_risk = case_when(
    Cancer %in% c(
      "Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma",
      "Lung Adenocarcinoma",
      "Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma",
      "Colon Adenocarcinoma",
      "Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma",
      "Stomach Adenocarcinoma"
    ) ~ "High cachectic",
    
    Cancer %in% c(
      "Glioblastoma Multiforme",
      "Ovary Serous Cystadenocarcinoma",
      "Breast Invasive Carcinoma",
      "Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma and Endocervical Adenocarcinoma",
      "Rectum Adenocarcinoma"
    ) ~ "Moderate cachectic",
    
    TRUE ~ "Low cachectic"  # all remaining cancers
  ))

tumour_rna$Cachexia_risk <- factor(tumour_rna$Cachexia_risk, 
                               levels = c("Low cachectic", "Moderate cachectic", "High cachectic"))
```


## Make Cancer column a factor

```{r, include=FALSE}
tumour_rna <- tumour_rna %>%
  mutate(Cancer = factor(Cancer, levels = cachexia_order))
```


## Filter genes

```{r, include=FALSE}
tnf_df <- tumour_rna %>%
  filter(Gene_symbol == "TNF")

ccl2_df <- tumour_rna %>%
  filter(Gene_symbol == "CCL2")

cxcl12_df <- tumour_rna %>%
  filter(Gene_symbol == "CXCL12")

osm_df <- tumour_rna %>%
  filter(Gene_symbol == "OSM")
```


## Plot 

### Plot TNF

```{r}
ggplot(tnf_df, aes(x = Cancer, y = pTPM)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 2, color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +  # points
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, color = "red", size = 0.7, fatten = 2) +  # mean line
  labs(
    title = "TNF pTPM across Cancer Types",
    x = "Cancer Type (ranked by cachexia potential)",
    y = "pTPM"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

#### Mean TNF pTPM values by Cancer type

```{r}
tnf_df %>%
  group_by(Cancer) %>%
  summarize(mean_pTPM = mean(pTPM, na.rm = TRUE))
```

## TNF differences between cachexia risk

### Mean TNF pTPM values by Cachexia_risk

```{r}
tnf_df %>%
  group_by(Cachexia_risk) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pTPM = mean(pTPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```


### 1-way ANOVA to compare pTPM values between cachexia risks

```{r}
tnf_anova <- aov(pTPM ~ Cachexia_risk, data = tnf_df)

summary(tnf_anova)
```

### Tukey's post-hoc testing

```{r}
tnf_posthoc <- TukeyHSD(tnf_anova)

tnf_posthoc$Cachexia_risk
```

### Plot (log transformed axes to see differences)

```{r}
ggplot(tnf_df, aes(x = Cachexia_risk, y = pTPM, fill = Cachexia_risk)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6, lwd = 0.8
  ) +
  stat_boxplot(
    geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2, lwd = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +  # log-transform the y-axis
  labs(
    title = "TNF",
    y = "pTPM (log10 scale)",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "High cachectic" = "#666666",
    "Moderate cachectic" = "lightgrey",
    "Low cachectic" = "white"
  ))
```

```{r}
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "High cachectic" = "#666666",
    "Moderate cachectic" = "lightgrey",
    "Low cachectic" = "white"
  ))
```


## OSM differences between cachexia risk

### Mean OSM pTPM values by Cachexia_risk

```{r}
osm_df %>%
  group_by(Cachexia_risk) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pTPM = mean(pTPM, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )
```

### 1-way ANOVA to compare pTPM values between cachexia risks

```{r}
osm_anova <- aov(pTPM ~ Cachexia_risk, data = osm_df)

summary(osm_anova)
```

### Tukey's post-hoc testing

```{r}
osm_posthoc <- TukeyHSD(osm_anova)

osm_posthoc$Cachexia_risk
```

### Plot (log transformed axes to see differences)

```{r}
ggplot(osm_df, aes(x = Cachexia_risk, y = pTPM, fill = Cachexia_risk)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6, lwd = 0.8
  ) +
  stat_boxplot(
    geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2, lwd = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +  # log-transform the y-axis
  labs(
    title = "OSM",
    y = "pTPM (log10 scale)",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "High cachectic" = "#666666",
    "Moderate cachectic" = "lightgrey",
    "Low cachectic" = "white"
  ))
```

# Read in tumour cptac

### NOTE - CPTAC is "Clinical Proteomic tumour Analysis Consortium". Measured as a logFC relative to healthy tissue.

```{r, include=FALSE}
tumour_cptac <- read_tsv("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/data/hpa/cancer_cptac.tsv")
```


## Identify logFC values of tumour secreted ligands (Tnf, Ccl12 which is Ccl2 in humans Cxcl12, Osm) found to regulate the muscle from our mouse analyses.

```{r}
target_proteins <- c("TNF", "CCL2", "CXCL12", "OSM")

tumour_cptac_targets <- tumour_cptac %>%
  filter(`Gene name` %in% target_proteins) %>%
  filter(`p-value adjusted` < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(p_plot = ifelse(`p-value adjusted` > 0.05, NA, `p-value adjusted`))
```

### NOTE - No OSM protein found in the tumour (apparently secreted by immune cells, it does have OSMR though). When filtering for p<0.05, only CXCL12 remains. 


## Order cancers from least to most cachectic

```{r, include=FALSE}
cachexia_order <- c(
  "Endometrioid AC",
  "Uterine CEC",
  "Head and Neck SQCC",
  "Renal cell carcinoma",
  "Colon AC",
  "Liver HC",
  "Lung AC",
  "Lung SQCC",
  "Pancreatic DAC"
)
```


## Plot

```{r}
ggplot(
  tumour_cptac_targets %>% mutate(Cancer = factor(Cancer, levels = cachexia_order)),
  aes(x = Cancer, y = logFC, fill = p_plot)
) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "blue",
    high = "red",
    limits = c(min(tumour_cptac_targets$p_plot, na.rm = TRUE), 0.05),
    na.value = "black",
    name = "Adjusted p-value"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-3, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Tumour CXCL12",
    x = "Cancer type (ranked by cachexia potential)",
    y = "logFC (relative to healthy tissue)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right"
  )
```

## Map mouse genes to human orthologs

### NOTE - I downloaded a file from BioMart that has matching human and mouse genes

```{r, include=FALSE}
orthologs <- read.table("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/human_mouse_orthologs.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "", fill = TRUE)

# Filter for high-confidence orthologs
orthologs_hc <- orthologs %>%
  filter(orthology_confidence == 1)

# Map mouse genes to human for Tnf/Ccl12/Cxcl12 targets
tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_human <- orthologs_hc %>%
  filter(mouse_gene_name %in% tnf_ccl12_cxcl12_targets) %>%
  pull(human_gene_name) %>% 
  unique()   # remove duplicates

# Map mouse genes to human for OSM targets

  filter(mouse_gene_name %in% osm_targets) %>%
  pull(human_gene_name) %>%
```

## Heatmap of DEGs for each gene in tnf_ccl2_cxcl12_targets_human

### DEGs by condition

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(pdac_muscle_immune) <- "orig.ident"

DEGs_immune_ws_v_ctl <- FindMarkers(pdac_muscle_immune, ident.1 = "PDAC_WS", ident.2 = "PDAC_CTL", logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
DEGs_immune_cac_v_ctl <- FindMarkers(pdac_muscle_immune, ident.1 = "PDAC_cachectic", ident.2 = "PDAC_CTL", logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)
DEGs_immune_cac_v_ws <- FindMarkers(pdac_muscle_immune, ident.1 = "PDAC_cachectic", ident.2 = "PDAC_WS", logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0.10, verbose = FALSE)

DEGs_immune_ws_v_ctl <- DEGs_immune_ws_v_ctl %>% 
  mutate(log10_p_val_adj = -log10(p_val_adj))
DEGs_immune_cac_v_ctl <- DEGs_immune_cac_v_ctl %>% 
  mutate(log10_p_val_adj = -log10(p_val_adj))
DEGs_immune_cac_v_ws <- DEGs_immune_cac_v_ws %>% 
  mutate(log10_p_val_adj = -log10(p_val_adj))
```


### See which genes are up in cachectic vs. CTL and cachectic vs. WS but not WS vs. CTL (no filter by p_val because too few cells, filtered by avg_log2FC > 0.2)

```{r}
# Filter each DEG table for significant upregulation
sig_cac_vs_ctl <- DEGs_immune_cac_v_ctl %>%
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0.2) %>%
  rownames()

sig_cac_vs_ws <- DEGs_immune_cac_v_ws %>%
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0.2) %>%
  rownames()

sig_ws_vs_ctl <- DEGs_immune_ws_v_ctl %>%
  filter(avg_log2FC > 0.2) %>%
  rownames()

# Genes that are significant in both cac comparisons but NOT in WS vs CTL
cachectic_immune_genes <- intersect(sig_cac_vs_ctl, sig_cac_vs_ws) %>%
  setdiff(sig_ws_vs_ctl)

# Show result
cachectic_immune_genes
```

```{r}
]

## Build heatmap matrix: rows = comparisons, columns = genes

# Heatmap with italicized human gene names
Heatmap(

  # Row names

  border = TRUE,
  column_title = "TNF/CCL2/CXCL12 Target Genes (avg_log2FC)"
)
```
